job.title: Assurance Manager
job.description:
A respected accounting firm is seeking an Assurance Manager to join its team. This opportunity is ideal for a public accounting professional who enjoys managing diverse client engagements, building trusted relationships, and mentoring team members. The role also offers opportunities to contribute to firm-wide quality initiatives and grow into a senior leadership position, with potential for future partnership.

Reporting to senior leadership, the Assurance Manager will oversee assurance engagements, maintain strong client relationships, and ensure the delivery of high-quality accounting services. The successful candidate will bring a broad public accounting background, sound technical knowledge, and the confidence to work directly with clients and their finance teams.

What You'll Do

  • Manage assurance engagements from planning through completion, ensuring work meets applicable professional standards and deadlines
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, building relationships and addressing accounting and financial reporting matters
  • Collaborate directly with client finance leaders and external stakeholders to resolve issues and provide practical guidance
  • Oversee multiple engagements, coordinate resources, and maintain consistent quality across client files
  • Review financial statements and engagement documentation for technical accuracy and compliance
  • Mentor and develop team members, providing feedback and guidance to strengthen technical capabilities
  • Work with firm leadership to improve engagement processes, client service, and overall operational efficiency
  • Contribute to internal quality management, regulatory compliance, and the consistent application of professional standards
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships and support the firm's continued success

What You Bring

  • A completed CPA designation is required
  • Progressive experience in public accounting, ideally within a small- to mid-sized accounting firm
  • Broad assurance experience and the ability to manage engagements involving varied client needs and levels of complexity
  • Strong understanding of applicable accounting and assurance standards
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work confidently with clients and senior stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining high-quality work
  • A collaborative leadership style and an interest in coaching and developing others
  • An interest in quality management, regulatory compliance, and professional standards
  • A proactive mindset, sound professional judgment, and motivation to take on broader leadership responsibilities

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to advance your career with an accounting firm that values strong client relationships, technical excellence, and professional development. You'll have meaningful involvement in client engagements, the opportunity to help develop the team, and exposure to broader firm operations.

job.title: Senior Cross-Border Tax Associate
job.description:
A well-regarded accounting firm is seeking a Cross-Border Tax professional to join its tax practice. This opportunity is ideal for someone with strong expertise in U.S. and Canadian personal taxation who enjoys working with complex tax matters and helping clients navigate their cross-border financial obligations.

Working alongside experienced tax professionals and firm leadership, you will prepare and review cross-border personal tax filings while contributing to a broader range of tax and advisory engagements outside the busy season. The position offers the opportunity to develop technical expertise across both U.S. and Canadian tax requirements, work on complex client matters, and expand into specialized advisory services. Professional development is encouraged, with support available for candidates pursuing relevant accounting qualifications.

What You'll Do

  • Prepare U.S. individual income tax returns and related filings for clients with cross-border tax obligations
  • Prepare Canadian personal income tax returns, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable tax legislation
  • Review client financial information and supporting documentation to identify tax considerations and ensure complete filings
  • Assist with year-end accounting work and other compliance-related assignments outside the personal tax season
  • Support estate-related engagements and tax planning matters involving individual and family financial affairs
  • Contribute to tax advisory projects, including restructuring strategies and reorganizations for high-net-worth individuals
  • Research cross-border tax issues and assist in preparing technical tax memoranda and client recommendations
  • Collaborate with colleagues and senior professionals to resolve complex tax matters and deliver practical client solutions
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant U.S. and Canadian tax regulations and reporting requirements

What You Bring

  • Strong hands-on experience preparing U.S. personal income tax returns, including Form 1040 and applicable supporting schedules and forms
  • Solid knowledge of Canadian personal income tax preparation and compliance
  • Relevant experience in public accounting or a professional tax services environment
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex tax information
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to technical accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain tax matters clearly
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines during peak tax periods
  • An interest in developing expertise in cross-border tax planning, estates, and tax advisory services

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to build specialized expertise in a technically challenging and rewarding area of taxation. You'll gain exposure to a diverse range of client matters, broaden your knowledge of U.S. and Canadian tax requirements, and develop skills that support long-term career progression.

job.title: Director, SOX
job.description:
A prominent organization is seeking an experienced audit professional to lead its internal controls program and strengthen financial reporting processes. This opportunity offers significant exposure to senior leadership, collaboration across diverse business units, and the chance to influence risk management and governance practices at an enterprise level.

Reporting to a senior audit leader, the Director will oversee the design, assessment, and ongoing evaluation of internal controls over financial reporting. This position combines program leadership, risk assessment, stakeholder engagement, and team development, with opportunities to contribute to broader internal audit and advisory initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end internal controls program to support regulatory compliance and reliable financial reporting
  • Identify key business processes, conduct process walkthroughs, and oversee the development of control documentation
  • Direct annual risk assessments and financial reporting scoping activities
  • Oversee control testing to assess design effectiveness and ongoing operational performance
  • Work with business stakeholders to investigate control gaps, evaluate risks, and develop practical remediation plans
  • Monitor testing progress, outstanding findings, and remediation activities, providing clear updates to senior leadership
  • Build productive relationships with finance leaders, process owners, external auditors, and other key stakeholders
  • Contribute to internal audit planning, risk assessments, and the development of audit procedures
  • Oversee audit engagements, including fieldwork, evidence evaluation, issue identification, and report preparation
  • Validate completed remediation activities and maintain appropriate documentation of outstanding issues
  • Coach and develop team members while coordinating external service providers where required
  • Support broader risk management, governance, and business improvement initiatives

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in internal audit, internal controls, accounting, or financial reporting
  • CPA designation; experience with a major accounting firm or an equivalent professional environment is an asset
  • Strong knowledge of SOX compliance, internal controls over financial reporting, risk assessment, and audit testing methodologies
  • Experience supporting publicly listed organizations subject to US regulatory requirements
  • Familiarity with US GAAP and financial reporting risks is beneficial
  • Background in financial services, investment management, or a related industry is an asset
  • Proven leadership experience, including mentoring professionals and managing complex projects
  • Strong analytical skills, sound professional judgment, and the ability to identify root causes and develop actionable solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt to changing business needs
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience using audit management, data analytics, or emerging technology tools
  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related discipline; additional professional certifications are an asset

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a visible leadership role within a complex, internationally focused organization. You'll collaborate with senior decision-makers, influence the effectiveness of enterprise-wide controls, and contribute to initiatives that strengthen governance and operational performance.

The organization offers a collaborative, high-performance environment with exposure to varied business operations, challenging assignments, and opportunities to develop your leadership capabilities while making a lasting impact on the finance and risk function.

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
A leading organization in the investment and financial services sector is seeking a Finance Manager to oversee corporate accounting and financial reporting activities. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced accounting professional who enjoys working across multiple business functions, improving financial processes, and supporting strategic decision-making in an international business environment.

Reporting to a senior finance leader, the Finance Manager will oversee core accounting operations, financial reporting, tax compliance, and intercompany transactions. Working closely with teams across finance, tax, treasury, and investment operations, this individual will help ensure accurate reporting, effective controls, and efficient financial processes.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee accounts payable activities, including invoice coding, cost allocations, payment reviews, and resolution of billing discrepancies.

  • Manage monthly accounts receivable and invoicing processes, ensuring accurate billing and timely recovery of expenses.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to facilitate reimbursements and maintain accurate intercompany balances.

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting activities, including journal entries, bank reconciliations, and financial transaction recording.

  • Review accounting entries and reporting materials prepared by junior team members to ensure accuracy and completeness.

  • Manage intercompany reconciliations, settlements, and related accounting adjustments in collaboration with internal stakeholders.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline accounting workflows, improve controls, and enhance operational efficiency through automation.

  • Maintain clear, accurate documentation of financial policies, procedures, and internal processes.

  • Support indirect tax filings and coordinate information required for annual corporate tax compliance and audit requests.

  • Prepare quarterly financial statements, reporting packages, and supporting analyses for senior leadership.

  • Coordinate reporting deliverables with international teams to ensure consistency, completeness, and adherence to deadlines.

  • Oversee financial calculations related to intercompany pricing and management fees.

  • Prepare cash flow analyses, fund movement schedules, and other financial reports to support business planning and executive decision-making.

What You Bring

  • CPA designation with approximately 5–7 years of experience in corporate accounting, financial reporting, or public accounting.

  • Experience in financial services, investment management, or a similarly complex corporate environment is an asset.

  • Previous leadership or supervisory experience, including reviewing work, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating team deliverables, is preferred.

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statement preparation, reconciliations, and tax compliance.

  • Experience managing intercompany transactions and coordinating financial reporting across multiple business units.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of standard office applications.

  • Familiarity with enterprise accounting systems; experience with financial automation tools is an asset.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and international teams.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a demonstrated interest in process improvement and professional development.

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a visible finance role within a sophisticated, globally connected organization. You'll gain exposure to complex accounting activities, collaborate with experienced professionals across multiple functions, and contribute to initiatives that improve reporting quality and operational effectiveness. The organization offers a collaborative, performance-driven environment where continuous learning, professional development, and thoughtful problem-solving are valued. For an accounting professional looking to broaden their expertise and develop their leadership capabilities, this role provides a strong platform for continued career growth.

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst
job.description:
A prominent organization in the investment and financial services sector is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to join its corporate finance team. This opportunity is ideal for an accounting professional looking to deepen their expertise in financial reporting, corporate accounting, and investment-related operations while working with stakeholders across multiple business functions.

Reporting to a senior finance leader, the Senior Financial Analyst will support accounting operations, financial reporting, tax compliance, and intercompany accounting activities. The successful candidate will work closely with finance and investment professionals to maintain accurate financial records, meet reporting deadlines, and identify opportunities to improve processes.

What You'll Do

  • Review invoice coding and cost allocations to ensure expenses are accurately recorded and assigned.

  • Monitor payment activities, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate the resolution of vendor billing issues.

  • Manage monthly invoicing activities and help ensure timely collection of outstanding reimbursements.

  • Prepare journal entries, complete bank reconciliations, and maintain accurate accounting records.

  • Perform intercompany reconciliations, process settlements, and record reimbursements in the appropriate accounts.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline accounting workflows and improve the accuracy and efficiency of financial processes.

  • Support ad hoc financial assignments and analysis requested by senior leadership and internal stakeholders.

  • Prepare supporting schedules for indirect tax filings and compile information for annual corporate tax returns and audit requests.

  • Assist with the preparation of quarterly financial statements, financial reporting packages, and related schedules.

  • Calculate and compile management fees and other investment-related financial information.

  • Prepare cash flow analyses, fund movement schedules, and financial reports to support management decisions.

What You Bring

  • CPA designation with approximately 3–5 years of experience in corporate accounting or public accounting.

  • Experience in financial services, investment management, or a similarly complex business environment is an asset.

  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial statement preparation.

  • Experience with intercompany accounting, expense allocations, and financial reporting processes.

  • Familiarity with tax compliance, audit support, and indirect tax reporting.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with standard office applications.

  • Experience with enterprise accounting systems; familiarity with financial automation tools is an asset.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.

  • Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

  • A proactive, organized, and adaptable approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

Why Join

Join a collaborative finance team where you can expand your accounting expertise and contribute to meaningful business decisions. This role provides exposure to complex corporate accounting activities, investment-related financial operations, and cross-functional projects. You'll have opportunities to strengthen your technical capabilities, work alongside experienced finance professionals, and build a foundation for future career progression in financial reporting, corporate finance, or investment-related accounting.

job.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
job.description:
A leading organization is seeking a Director of Financial Planning & Analysis to support strategic planning, financial performance management, and executive decision-making. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced finance professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with leadership experience and enjoys working across complex business operations.

 

Reporting to a senior finance executive, the Director will oversee financial planning, forecasting, and consolidated reporting for a diverse investment business. The role combines hands-on financial analysis with team leadership, stakeholder collaboration, and process improvement.

 

What You'll Do

  • Lead consolidated financial planning and forecasting activities, including annual business plans, quarterly projections, and financial performance reporting
  • Review financial results, forecasts, and business plans to assess accuracy, identify trends, and evaluate performance against established targets
  • Analyze key business drivers and financial variances, translating complex data into actionable insights and recommendations
  • Coordinate reporting timelines and deliverables across multiple business units, ensuring consistency, completeness, and timely submission of financial information
  • Oversee financial reporting processes and planning systems, identifying opportunities to improve reporting quality, functionality, and efficiency
  • Prepare and review executive presentations, financial analyses, and performance summaries for senior leadership
  • Conduct profitability analysis across business segments to identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Partner with finance leaders and operational stakeholders to support planning activities, resolve reporting issues, and strengthen financial processes
  • Manage and develop a team of Financial Analysts while remaining actively involved in detailed analysis and review of key deliverables
  • Build strong working relationships across the organization to encourage collaboration, accountability, and effective problem-solving
  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance the scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of financial planning and reporting

 

What You Bring

  • A university degree in finance, accounting, or a related business discipline
  • CPA designation
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis, financial reporting, or a related finance function
  • 1–2 years of experience managing or developing finance professionals
  • Strong understanding of financial forecasting, budgeting, consolidated reporting, and performance analysis
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Experience with financial planning and reporting systems; familiarity with enterprise planning platforms is an asset
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and develop practical recommendations
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage with senior leadership
  • Strong organizational skills, sound professional judgment, and a commitment to accuracy and continuous improvement

 

Why Join

This is an opportunity to take on a visible leadership role within a sophisticated, multi-business organization. You'll collaborate with senior stakeholders, contribute to important financial and strategic decisions, and help shape the evolution of the FP&A function.

 

The organization offers a collaborative, performance-driven environment where analytical thinking, professional development, and continuous improvement are valued. You'll have the opportunity to lead a team, strengthen financial processes, and broaden your exposure to complex business operations.

job.title: Manager, Private Credit Fund Accounting
job.description:
An established financial services provider specializing in alternative investment fund accounting is seeking a Manager, Private Credit Fund Accounting to join its team on an initial six-month contract, with the possibility of extension.This opportunity is ideal for an experienced fund accounting professional with private credit or private debt experience. The successful candidate will oversee fund accounting deliverables, review investment accounting and financial reporting, and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial information for complex credit investment funds.

About the Role

Reporting to senior leadership, you will oversee private credit fund accounting and financial reporting, including Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations, investment accounting, financial statements, and investor allocations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience accounting for private credit funds, reviewing fund financials, and ensuring accurate and timely accounting deliverables. Strong technical accounting knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to provide guidance on complex accounting matters are essential to success in this role.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee and review fund accounting and financial reporting for private credit funds.
  • Review periodic NAV calculations, trial balances, general ledger balances, financial statements, and investor allocations.
  • Review accounting for private credit investments, including direct loans, senior secured debt, subordinated debt, and mezzanine financing.
  • Review loan activity, interest income accruals, amortization schedules, and realized and unrealized gains and losses.
  • Review fund expenses, including management fees, administration fees, carried interest, and other applicable charges.
  • Review accounting for capital calls, distributions, and investor allocations to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Interpret partnership agreements, credit agreements, offering memorandums, and other fund documentation to determine appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Ensure fund accounting and financial reporting comply with applicable accounting standards and reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate with clients, internal accounting teams, and external auditors to resolve technical accounting and financial reporting issues.
  • Review financial statements and supporting schedules to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Identify and resolve complex fund accounting discrepancies and valuation-related accounting issues.
  • Provide technical accounting guidance and review support to fund accounting team members.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong experience in fund accounting, fund administration, or investment accounting, preferably within a private credit or private debt environment.
  • Hands-on experience with NAV calculations, loan interest accruals, investment accounting, capital calls, distributions, investor allocations, and fund-level financial reporting.
  • Knowledge of private credit products, including direct lending, senior secured loans, mezzanine financing, distressed debt, and other credit instruments.
  • Experience reviewing general ledgers, trial balances, financial statements, and supporting fund accounting schedules.
  • Knowledge of US GAAP, Canadian GAAP, IFRS, or other applicable accounting frameworks.
  • Previous supervisory, team leadership, or senior-level fund accounting review experience.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with fund accounting platforms is an asset.
  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.

Why Join?

This contract opportunity offers the chance to apply your private credit fund accounting expertise in a specialized alternative investments environment. You will work with complex credit investment structures, contribute to accurate financial reporting, and provide technical accounting support within an experienced fund accounting team.

job.title: Finance Systems Specialist
job.description:
A growing multi-business organization is seeking a Finance Systems Specialist to support financial system implementations, optimize business processes, and improve the effectiveness of finance operations. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for a hands-on systems professional who combines strong ERP expertise with practical business knowledge and enjoys working directly with stakeholders to turn complex requirements into effective solutions.

Reporting to finance leadership, you will support system implementations, enhancements, and ongoing optimization across multiple business units. You will work closely with finance teams, business leaders, IT partners, and external consultants to improve workflows, strengthen financial controls, and drive user adoption.

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate financial system implementations, enhancements, and post-launch activities across multiple business units.

  • Manage day-to-day system support requests, prioritize issues, assess business impacts, and coordinate timely resolutions.

  • Configure and improve system workflows, user permissions, reports, and other functional capabilities to meet business needs.

  • Partner with finance teams to improve processes related to billing, revenue recognition, intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and period-end reporting.

  • Gather business requirements, evaluate potential solutions, and translate operational needs into clear functional specifications.

  • Coordinate stakeholders, consultants, and technical teams throughout testing, implementation, and deployment activities.

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve data quality, and establish consistent practices across business units.

  • Develop user documentation, deliver training, and support finance teams through system and process changes.

  • Establish standardized reporting practices, reconciliation templates, and repeatable workflows.

  • Support audit and compliance requirements by maintaining appropriate documentation, approvals, and system controls.

  • Manage competing priorities, communicate project progress, and escalate risks or outstanding issues when necessary.

 
What You Bring

  • A bachelor's degree in information systems, business, accounting, finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience with ERP systems, functional administration, implementations, or finance systems optimization.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting system implementations, significant enhancements, or complex troubleshooting initiatives.

  • Strong functional knowledge of financial systems, including general ledger, accounts payable, intercompany accounting, and banking processes.

  • Experience with revenue management, billing, or project accounting functionality is highly desirable.

  • An understanding of the accounting principles behind system configurations, including revenue recognition, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.

  • Experience gathering requirements, assessing business impacts, and translating stakeholder needs into practical system solutions.

  • Strong project coordination skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives, deadlines, and support requests simultaneously.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to guide non-technical users and work effectively with leadership and external partners.

  • A proactive, adaptable approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to take ownership and move work forward independently.

  • Experience supporting multiple entities or business units is an asset.

  • Relevant system certifications, project management training, or technical customization experience are considered advantages.

 

Why Join

This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on how finance teams operate across a diverse business environment. You'll gain exposure to multiple implementations, collaborate with stakeholders across finance and technology, and help shape more efficient, scalable processes.The role offers variety, ownership, and the opportunity to expand your systems and project leadership capabilities while delivering improvements that benefit teams across the organization.

job.title: Controller
job.description:
A mission-driven organization is seeking a Controller to lead its accounting function and support strong financial management across a range of programs and funding sources. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced accounting professional who combines technical expertise with hands-on leadership, analytical thinking, and a genuine interest in the non-profit sector.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Controller will oversee day-to-day accounting operations, lead a finance team, and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial reporting. This role requires someone who can independently prepare and review financial statements, investigate variances, and provide meaningful insights to support leadership decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee daily accounting operations and provide leadership, guidance, and development to the finance team.
  • Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable accounting standards.
  • Manage month-end and year-end closing activities, including account reconciliations, supporting schedules, and working papers.
  • Analyze financial results, investigate variances, and identify the underlying factors affecting financial performance.
  • Oversee grant accounting, government funding, restricted contributions, and related financial reporting requirements.
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow reporting to support effective financial planning.
  • Ensure compliance with Canadian accounting standards applicable to not-for-profit organizations and relevant reporting obligations.
  • Coordinate external audits and oversee year-end reporting requirements.
  • Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities.
  • Maintain effective internal controls, accounting policies, and financial procedures.
  • Provide clear financial analysis and reporting to the CFO and other organizational leaders.
  • Lead the implementation of an updated payroll system, coordinating the transition, supporting process improvements, and helping ensure a smooth rollout.

What You Bring

  • CPA designation is required.
  • Previous accounting experience within a non-profit or charitable organization is essential.
  • Proven experience in a Controller or senior Accounting Manager role, including responsibility for managing a finance team.
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge and hands-on experience preparing financial statements independently.
  • Solid understanding of non-profit accounting, government funding, grants, restricted contributions, and related reporting requirements.
  • Experience managing month-end and year-end close processes, reconciliations, and external audits.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to question results, investigate discrepancies, and understand the drivers behind financial performance.
  • Experience overseeing core accounting functions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger.
  • Ability to balance people leadership with direct involvement in accounting operations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with finance colleagues and senior leadership.
  • A practical, inquisitive approach and the ability to step into an established finance function and contribute effectively.
  • Experience with payroll system implementations or process improvement initiatives is an asset.

Why Join

This is an opportunity to contribute your financial expertise to an organization with a meaningful community impact. You'll play an important role in supporting responsible stewardship of funding, strengthening financial reporting, and helping ensure resources are managed effectively across programs and services.

job.title: Vice President, Private Credit Fund Accounting
job.description:
An established global financial services provider specializing in alternative investment fund administration is seeking a Vice President, Private Credit Fund Accounting to join its team on an initial six-month contract, with the possibility of extension.This opportunity is suited to an experienced fund accounting professional with a background in private credit, private debt, private equity, or other private markets investments. The successful candidate will oversee fund accounting deliverables, review complex investment accounting and financial reporting, and ensure the accuracy and integrity of fund-level financial information.

About the Role

The role requires a strong foundation in private markets fund accounting, with particular relevance to private credit investment structures. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with fund financial reporting, NAV calculations, investment accounting, and investor allocations.Experience with private credit or private debt funds is highly relevant, while candidates with broader private equity or private markets fund accounting experience may also be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Oversee and review fund accounting deliverables for alternative investment funds, with a focus on private credit.
  • Review periodic Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations, trial balances, financial statements, and investor allocations.

This is an opportunity to work with an established global financial services organization and apply your fund accounting expertise within the alternative investments industry. The initial six-month contract offers the potential for extension and the opportunity to contribute to complex private markets fund accounting and financial reporting.

job.title: Purchasing & Inventory Coordinator
job.description:
A well-regarded organization in the manufacturing sector is seeking a Purchasing & Inventory Coordinator to support its procurement, inventory management, and finance operations. This role is ideal for an organized, hands-on professional who enjoys working with suppliers, improving processes, and ensuring materials are available to support business needs.

Reporting to a senior finance leader, you will coordinate purchasing activities, maintain accurate inventory records, and support supplier relationships across the business. Working closely with finance, operations, and technical teams, you will help optimize stock levels, improve purchasing efficiency, and maintain reliable supply chain processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Create, track, and manage purchase orders while coordinating with suppliers to support timely delivery
  • Source materials and components, build strong supplier relationships, and negotiate competitive pricing
  • Reconcile supplier invoices against received goods and maintain accurate purchasing and accounting records
  • Manage supplier accounts, maintain vendor information, and support account setup and documentation requirements
  • Maintain contractor records and ensure required insurance and compliance documentation is up to date
  • Monitor inventory levels, maintain appropriate safety stock, and reduce excess or obsolete materials
  • Collaborate with technical and operational teams to coordinate component changes and minimize waste
  • Maintain inventory accuracy through labeling, recordkeeping, and regular stock counts
  • Track delivery schedules, follow up on outstanding orders, and assist with shipping and receiving activities
  • Prepare purchasing updates and communicate delivery status to relevant departments
  • Contribute to sourcing initiatives, quality management processes, and purchasing-related audits
  • Provide general administrative and finance support to the broader team as required

What You Bring

  • At least 3 years of hands-on purchasing or procurement experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment
  • Experience using material planning or inventory management systems, including familiarity with bills of materials
  • Working knowledge of accounting software and supplier invoice processing
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and common document management tools
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and perform effectively in a deadline-driven environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • A reliable, professional, and collaborative approach to working with colleagues and external partners
  • Experience with inventory optimization, continuous improvement practices, or quality management processes is an asset

Why Join

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative team where your contributions will directly support purchasing efficiency, inventory accuracy, and day-to-day business operations. You will gain exposure to cross-functional projects, supplier management, and process improvement initiatives while developing your skills across procurement, inventory control, and finance administration.

job.title: Junior Staff Accountant
job.description:
A growing professional services organization is seeking a Junior Staff Accountant to join its finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career accounting professional to build a strong technical foundation, gain hands-on experience, and develop their career within a supportive team environment.

Reporting to a senior member of the accounting team, the Junior Staff Accountant will assist with day-to-day accounting activities, financial reporting, and account reconciliations. This position is ideal for someone with a strong understanding of accounting principles who is eager to apply their knowledge in a practical setting, learn from experienced colleagues, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist with the preparation and maintenance of financial records and accounting schedules
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities, including account reconciliations and journal entries
  • Help prepare financial statements and supporting documentation
  • Review transactions and investigate discrepancies to ensure the accuracy of financial information
  • Assist with accounts payable, accounts receivable, and other general accounting activities as required
  • Maintain organized financial documentation and ensure records are complete and up to date
  • Collaborate with team members to support reporting deadlines and ongoing accounting requirements
  • Contribute to process improvements and take on additional responsibilities as your skills and experience develop

What You Bring

  • A university degree or college diploma in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline
  • Recent graduate status or approximately one year of experience in public accounting or a related accounting role
  • A solid understanding of fundamental accounting principles
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work
  • Good analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

job.title: Cost Accountant

job.title: Construction Accountant

  • Ability to build effective working relationships with project managers, operational teams, vendors, and senior leadership

job.title: Controller

job.title: Project Accountant

Why Join

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing organization during an exciting stage of project development. You'll play a key role in building financial processes, working alongside operational teams, and contributing directly to the success of a major capital project. If you're looking for a broad, hands-on accounting role with meaningful impact, strong autonomy, and long-term growth potential, this position offers an excellent next step in your career.

 

Comptable de projet

Une organisation axée sur les projets dans le secteur des ressources naturelles et des infrastructures est à la recherche d'un Comptable de projet pour se joindre à son équipe des finances afin de soutenir un important projet de développement au Québec. Il s'agit d'une excellente occasion de travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, de contribuer à la réussite financière d'un projet d'envergure et de participer à la mise en place des processus financiers dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution.

À propos du poste

Relevant d'un membre senior de l'équipe des finances, le Comptable de projet jouera un rôle clé dans la gestion financière d'un important projet de développement. Ce poste est principalement axé sur la comptabilité de projet plutôt que sur la comptabilité corporative traditionnelle. Vous serez impliqué dans le suivi des coûts de projet, la production de rapports financiers, le soutien aux activités d'approvisionnement ainsi que l'amélioration des processus financiers. À mesure que le projet évoluera, les responsabilités associées au poste se développeront également, offrant d'excellentes possibilités de croissance professionnelle.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Assurer le suivi des coûts, des budgets et des dépenses du projet afin de soutenir une gestion financière efficace.
  • Préparer les rapports financiers, les prévisions et les analyses destinés aux équipes des finances et des opérations.
  • Effectuer le suivi des engagements financiers, des répartitions de coûts et des dépenses tout au long du cycle de vie du projet.
  • Soutenir les activités comptables liées aux approvisionnements, notamment le traitement des factures, les rapprochements avec les fournisseurs et le suivi des coûts.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de projet et les équipes opérationnelles afin de fournir des analyses financières favorisant une prise de décision éclairée.
  • Participer aux activités de clôture de fin de mois, aux rapprochements de comptes et à la production des rapports financiers liés au projet.
  • Identifier des occasions d'améliorer les processus financiers, les contrôles internes et les outils de production de rapports à mesure que le projet progresse.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la documentation de procédures financières évolutives ainsi que des meilleures pratiques.
  • Participer à des projets spéciaux et à d'autres initiatives financières selon les besoins de l'organisation.
  • Se déplacer au site du projet au Québec, au besoin, afin de collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Minimum de trois (3) années d'expérience en comptabilité de projet ou en finance de projet.
  • Expérience acquise dans les secteurs minier, de la construction, de l'ingénierie, des infrastructures ou dans tout autre environnement axé sur les projets.
  • Excellente compréhension du suivi des coûts de projet, de la budgétisation, de l'analyse des coûts et de la production de rapports financiers.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en français et en anglais.
  • Expérience avec un système ERP ainsi qu'une très bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Excel.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome, à gérer plusieurs priorités et à évoluer dans un environnement en constante évolution.
  • Excellentes habiletés en communication et en collaboration avec les équipes des finances et des opérations.
  • Le titre de CPA constitue un atout, mais n'est pas une exigence.
  • Disponibilité pour se déplacer sur le site du projet au Québec lorsque requis.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de vous joindre à une organisation à une étape clé du développement d'un projet majeur. Vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la mise en place des processus financiers, collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles et contribuerez directement au succès d'un important projet d'investissement. Si vous recherchez un poste diversifié, concret et offrant une grande autonomie, où vous pourrez avoir un impact réel tout en poursuivant votre développement professionnel, cette opportunité pourrait représenter la prochaine étape de votre carrière.
